mainWall.label: Main walls
mainWall.tip: Most of the outside walls, about 60% of the look.

secondSurface.label: Second colour
secondSurface.tip: A block or band in a second colour or material, about 30% of the look. Here: the stair tower and the walls behind the balconies.

featureWall.label: Feature wall
featureWall.tip: The special 10%: wood, stone, brick or fluted panels. Here: the full-height strip in the recess beside the balconies.

base.label: Plinth (base band)
base.tip: Plinth = the bottom band of the building, about 0 to 0.6 m high. It takes rain splash and dust, so a darker colour helps.

roofEdge.label: Roof edge
roofEdge.tip: The parapet top (coping) and roof edges. A parapet is the low wall around the terrace.

trim.label: Slab edges and trims
trim.tip: Edges of floor slabs and balconies, and other thin bands.

soffit.label: Ceiling under balconies
soffit.tip: Soffit = the underside of a balcony, canopy or overhang, seen when you look up.

column.label: Parking columns
column.tip: The pillars in the stilt parking.

balconyFront.label: Balcony walls
balconyFront.tip: The solid lower wall of each balcony.

sill.label: Window sills
sill.tip: The ledge under each window that throws rain off the wall.

windowSurround.label: Window box frames
windowSurround.tip: A projecting box frame around a window. It shades the glass and adds depth.

railing.label: Railings and metal
railing.tip: Balcony railings, rail caps and other metal.

fins.label: Fins and slats
fins.tip: Thin vertical blades in front of a window or balcony. They cut low sun and add rhythm.

slats.label: Wood slats and louvers
slats.tip: Louvers = rows of thin blades (wood-look) with gaps, in front of a wall or window. They give shade and privacy but let air through.

jaali.label: Jaali screen
jaali.tip: Jaali = a perforated screen (brick, concrete blocks or laser-cut metal) that lets light and breeze in but keeps sun and eyes out.

sunshade.label: Sunshades
sunshade.tip: A projecting ledge (chajja) above a window that blocks high sun and rain.

pergola.label: Pergola
pergola.tip: An open frame of beams on the terrace that gives dappled shade.

canopy.label: Entrance canopy
canopy.tip: A small roof over an entrance.

compoundWall.label: Compound wall
compoundWall.tip: The boundary wall around the plot.

interior.label: Inside (behind glass)
interior.tip: The rooms you glimpse through the windows.

context.label: Surroundings
context.tip: Terrace floor and the land around the plot.
